title: Notifications
subtitle: Choose what we're allowed to tell you about

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.body: Notifications follow your favourites and interests. That takes an account.

permissionMissing.heading: Permission missing
permissionMissing.body: Notifications are disabled for somes in your system settings. Without it, this device can't receive push messages.

activationFailed.heading: Push couldn't be turned on
activationFailed.body: Permission is granted, but this device couldn't register for push. That's on the app, not your settings. Please try again later.

loadError: Settings couldn't be loaded. Pull down the page to try again.

send_new_vote_results.label: New vote results
send_new_vote_results.description: Every new result, regardless of your favourites.

send_new_vote_result_by_favo.label: Favourited votes
send_new_vote_result_by_favo.description: Only results for votes in your favourites.

send_new_delegate_activity.label: Favourited MPs' activity
send_new_delegate_activity.description: Speeches, questions and votes from your favourites.

send_new_ministrial_prop.label: New ministerial drafts
send_new_ministrial_prop.description: Every new draft, regardless of your interests.

send_new_ministrial_prop_by_favo.label: Ministerial drafts matching your interests
send_new_ministrial_prop_by_favo.description: Only drafts that match your interests.

send_new_decree.label: New decrees
send_new_decree.description: Every new decree, regardless of your interests.

send_new_decree_by_favo.label: Decrees matching your interests
send_new_decree_by_favo.description: Only decrees that match your interests.

send_new_proposal.label: New motions
send_new_proposal.description: Every new motion, regardless of your interests.

send_new_proposal_by_favo.label: Motions matching your interests
send_new_proposal_by_favo.description: Only motions that match your interests.

mail.heading: Email notifications
mail.caption: These emails go to your account's address, regardless of this device.

push.heading: Push notifications
push.unsupported: Push only works on a real device, not in the simulator.
push.failed: This device couldn't register for push. Tap again to retry.
push.deviceOnlyNotice: This selection applies to all your devices. For anything to arrive on this device, the switch above has to be turned on.
